item.title: Discord
item.content:encoded:
11/7/2023 Update:
We now have a Discord server set up for discussion of this site. The link is below, feel free to join and contribute!
https://discord.gg/5RfjSXKGg4

Original Post:
What do you all think of setting up a Discord server for discussions on this page? I'm asking because the spam on here is getting out of control and I'm only a moderator so the best I can do is move the spam to the deleted topics folder. I try and check it at least once a day, but if I miss a day or two it's a good 10 minute task to clear the 2-3 pages of crap.

At this point, I don't think the page owner is going to be coming back and from what I've read it's pretty difficult/impossible to take control of a wikidot page from an absent owner.

I know I'm not as active on here as I used to be, real life gets in the way unfortunately. I'll keep this topic pinned so it doesn't get buried.
